page.layout: One blank page with no printed text of its own. Only show-through from the title page on the other side is visible: a mirrored title block at the top, a mirrored woodcut ornament in the centre, and a mirrored imprint block with a date at the foot.
page.notes: The page is blank apart from show-through. The mirrored text at the top (a title in capitals, with the lines "TIGVRINI AD IACOBVM" and "ANDREAE TRIPLEX" below it), the mirrored list of items in the upper half, the mirrored imprint at the foot, and the faint woodcut in the centre are all bleed-through from the recto and are not transcribed. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed on this page. Stains and a digitiser's margin are not transcribed.
